name: Connectors and terminals
summary: Plugs, sockets, terminals and wire joints: the bits that join wires and boards.
uses: Joining batteries, panels and loads safely
identify: Everywhere wires end: XT60 and Anderson plugs on RC and e-bike gear, MC4 on solar panels, spade and ring terminals in cars and appliances, terminal blocks in control panels, and JST and Dupont headers on boards.
test: Check pins aren’t burnt, corroded or loose. Measure continuity through the joint while wiggling the wire.
